blurb: SyteraYoga offers diverse yoga classes for all levels, including Vinyasa Flow, Power Flow, Slow Flow & Stretch, Ashtanga Yoga, SPA Yoga®, Trapeze Yoga, Yoga for Beginners, and more. Classes are available in person at their Vienna, VA studio and live-streamed online, with recordings accessible for three days after class. They also specialize in private yoga sessions for individuals, couples, and groups, and offer the unique Nadi Ball Method® for fascia fitness and myofascial massage.
extraNote: All payments for classes, packages, and memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable · Auto-renew passes can be cancelled anytime and put on hold when away · Late arrivals should arrive 5-10 minutes early for check-in and setup · At the studio address 901 Glyndon St., SE, #102 Vienna, VA 22180 for in-person classes
